trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's complimentary Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack essentials, and review your park tickets and plans for the week.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the resort's grab-and-go market or a vending machine snack — keep it light since it's nearly midnight

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is at 22:30, so Day 1 is purely a travel and check-in day. Rest up — you have a big week ahead! Pre-purchase discounted park tickets online (Undercover Tourist or Disney's official site) before the trip to save 10-20%. Download the My Disney Experience app tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Start with the most popular rides: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Haunted Mansion. Use the free Lightning Lane Multi Pass strategically for top attractions. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland early.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Liberty Square and Frontierland. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check the app for timing, usually early afternoon). Ride Pirates of the Caribbean and Splash Mountain. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed to avoid peak heat and crowds (2–4 PM is typically the busiest and hottest).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show (typically at 9:00 PM). Ride a few more attractions with shorter evening wait times. Head back to the resort by 10:30 PM.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the resort before heading out — grab cereal, fruit, or yogurt from the resort marketplace to save money. Budget: ~$5-8 per person
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — affordable counter-service with clam chowder, fish and chips, and sandwiches. Budget: ~$12-15 per person
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Cafe in Frontierland — counter-service Tex-Mex with a generous free toppings bar. Budget: ~$13-16 per person

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the crown jewel of Disney World. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle — free water is available at any quick-service counter. Purchase a refillable resort mug (~$22) for unlimited drinks at resort beverage stations all week. Arrive 30 minutes before park opening for best results.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT at rope drop. Start in World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane — book immediately at 7 AM on the app). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE. Explore World Nature and ride Soarin' Around the World early before lines build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the World Showcase — 11 international pavilions representing countries like Mexico, Norway, Japan, France, and more. Catch cultural performances and browse unique shops. Ride Frozen Ever After in Norway and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in France (use Lightning Lane if available). Browse the EPCOT International Festival offerings (seasonal food booths — great for budget snacking).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular — Luminous: The Symphony of Us (check app for timing). Explore the illuminated World Showcase lagoon. Head back to resort by 10 PM.

meals.breakfast: Resort grab-and-go or pack a light snack from your room. Budget: ~$5-8 per person
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — one of EPCOT's best value counter-service spots with rotating healthy and hearty options. Budget: ~$12-15 per person
meals.dinner: Sample 2-3 small plates from the World Showcase food booths (if a festival is running) OR dine at La Cantina de San Angel in Mexico — affordable outdoor counter-service with tacos and nachos by the lagoon. Budget: ~$14-18 per person

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear very comfortable shoes. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11 AM, so use the morning for Future World/World Discovery rides. If the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival or Flower & Garden Festival is running in June 2027, food booth small plates (~$5-9 each) make for a fun and budget-friendly progressive dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Arrive at Hollywood Studios at rope drop. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Rise of the Resistance (join the virtual queue or Lightning Lane at 7 AM sharp — it fills instantly). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore the immersive Galaxy's Edge land and grab a blue or green milk from the Milk Stand as a fun experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania. Then visit Sunset Boulevard for Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check app for times). Take a short rest break during peak afternoon heat.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular (check app for showtimes — typically two shows on busy days; arrive 45 minutes early for good seating). It's free with park admission and absolutely worth it. Head back to resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Pack snacks from the resort or eat a quick breakfast at the resort food court before heading out. Budget: ~$5-8 per person
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fun themed counter-service with grilled cheese, totchos (tater tot nachos), and lunch box tarts. Budget: ~$11-14 per person
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — one of Hollywood Studios' most affordable counter-service options with burgers, chicken, and wraps. Budget: ~$12-15 per person

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is extremely popular — Rise of the Resistance is the #1 most in-demand attraction at all of Disney World. Set your alarm for 6:55 AM to secure a Lightning Lane or virtual queue spot at exactly 7:00 AM. The park can feel very crowded mid-day, so use the afternoon rest strategy and return refreshed for the evening show.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Animal Kingdom at rope drop. Start with Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora — The World of Avatar (the #1 most popular ride; lines can exceed 2 hours by 9:30 AM). Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby. Explore the breathtaking Pandora land in the morning light — it's especially magical.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take the Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 20-minute open-air safari through a savanna with real African animals (lions, elephants, giraffes, and more). Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. By 2 PM, the park gets very hot — head back to the Aegean Bliss Resort and enjoy the pool for the afternoon. This is a great money-saving strategy (no extra cost!) and a needed rest day mid-trip.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Animal Kingdom for the Rivers of Light nighttime show or Festival of the Lion King stage show (check app for times). Alternatively, enjoy a relaxed evening at the resort — use the hot tub, grab resort snacks, and recharge for the final two park days.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — use your refillable mug for coffee/juice and grab a packaged pastry or fruit from the marketplace. Budget: ~$5-8 per person
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Animal Kingdom — one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with a beautiful waterfront seating area. Budget: ~$13-17 per person
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — healthy, customizable bowls with proteins and bases; excellent value and food quality for a Disney counter-service. Budget: ~$14-17 per person OR cook simple meals in the room if your resort room has a kitchenette to save money

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (often by 8–9 PM), which is why the afternoon pool break and evening return works perfectly. The afternoon pool break is a smart budget and energy strategy — you avoid the hottest, most crowded hours and return refreshed. Check the app for exact park hours.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning at the resort. Take advantage of the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront amenities — swim, walk along the waterfront, and enjoy a slow breakfast. This is your budget recovery and relaxation day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take the free Disney bus or boat to Disney Springs — Disney's free outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required!). Explore the unique shops, browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), visit the LEGO Store, and enjoy free street entertainment and live music. Browse the food hall options at the Edison or Polite Pig for affordable eats.
day_by_day.evening: Continue enjoying Disney Springs into the evening — the atmosphere is especially lively at night with lights, music, and entertainment. Watch free street performers. Head back to the resort by 9–10 PM and pack your bag for your final park day tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — use your refillable mug and pack room snacks. Budget: ~$5-10 per person
meals.lunch: Polite Pig at Disney Springs — wood-fired BBQ with excellent cocktails and a casual atmosphere; one of the best value sit-down options at Disney Springs. Budget: ~$15-20 per person
meals.dinner: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs — Guy Fieri's chicken tender restaurant with 22 dipping sauces; fun, affordable, and delicious. Budget: ~$12-15 per person

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely FREE to enter and explore — no park ticket needed. This is a great way to enjoy the Disney magic while giving your feet (and wallet) a rest from the theme parks. Free parking is also available if you have a rental car. Use this day to buy any souvenirs since Disney Springs sometimes has slightly better prices than the parks.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-21 (Final Park Day — Magic Kingdom or Favorite Revisit)
day_by_day.morning: Use your final park day to revisit your favorite park or any rides you missed. Magic Kingdom is recommended for a farewell day — it's the most iconic and emotionally satisfying way to end a Disney trip. Arrive at rope drop and prioritize any must-do rides you didn't get to earlier in the week. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs from park shops.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a final leisurely afternoon in the park. Revisit favorite attractions, catch any shows or parades you missed, and soak in the Disney atmosphere. Take photos in front of Cinderella Castle. By 3–4 PM, start heading back to the resort to begin packing and checkout preparations if your departure is the next day.
day_by_day.evening: Final dinner at the resort or a nearby budget-friendly spot. Pack your bags, organize receipts, and reflect on the magical week. If your flight is early the next morning, arrange transportation the night before. Enjoy one last evening stroll along the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — use every last drop from your refillable mug! Budget: ~$5-8 per person
meals.lunch: Casey's Corner at Magic Kingdom — classic American hot dogs and corn dog nuggets with great theming on Main Street USA. Budget: ~$10-13 per person
meals.dinner: Resort dining — treat yourself to a slightly nicer resort restaurant meal as a farewell dinner, or use leftover room snacks and order a pizza delivery to the resort to save money on the last night. Budget: ~$15-25 per person

day_by_day.notes: On your last park day, focus on joy over efficiency — don't stress about riding everything. The My Disney Experience app will show real-time wait times; use single rider lines where available to save time. Return your refillable mug to the resort (it's yours to keep as a souvenir!). Confirm your departure transportation the night before. Total estimated budget for the week (excluding flights and hotel): $150-200 per person for food + Lightning Lane passes if purchased selectively.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack essentials, and familiarize yourself with the resort amenities. Pick up any snacks from the resort gift shop or grab a light bite at the hotel bar if still open.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at a quick airport eatery
meals.dinner: Late-night snack or light meal at the Aegean Bliss Resort hotel bar/lounge upon arrival (expect limited options after 22:30)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 very light — you're arriving at 10:30 PM. Lay out park essentials the night before: comfortable shoes, sunscreen, ponchos, and portable chargers. Download the My Disney Experience app and link your resort reservation and tickets before bed. Get to sleep early to maximize energy for Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure begins! Arrive at Magic Kingdom at rope drop (typically 8:00–9:00 AM). Take advantage of early morning crowds by heading straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically. Grab a Mickey-shaped breakfast treat from Main Street Bakery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, Pirates of the Caribbean, and Haunted Mansion. Take a mid-afternoon break during peak heat (1:00–3:00 PM) at a sit-down restaurant or air-conditioned show like the Hall of Presidents or Mickey's PhilharMagic. Return to rides as crowds thin slightly.
day_by_day.evening: Position yourselves along Main Street U.S.A. or the hub area for the Magic Kingdom Festival of Fantasy Parade (check times in the app). Stay for the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle, typically around 9:00 PM. Exit after fireworks via the resort monorail or ferry back to your transportation.

meals.breakfast: Main Street Bakery (Casey's Corner area) — Mickey waffles, coffee, and pastries (~$12–$18 per person)
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — clam chowder, lobster roll, and fish & chips at mid-range pricing (~$15–$22 per person)
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland — French-inspired cuisine in the Beast's enchanted castle; book advance dining reservations (ADR) at 60 days out (~$25–$45 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book Be Our Guest dinner reservation well in advance via the My Disney Experience app. Wear lightweight, breathable clothing — June in Orlando is hot and humid (highs around 90°F/32°C). Bring a refillable water bottle; free ice water is available at any quick-service location. Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass for this day.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience. Arrive at park opening and head immediately to Galaxy's Edge. Join the virtual queue or purchase Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides). While waiting, explore Black Spire Outpost, interact with Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities, and meet Star Wars characters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (advance reservation required, ~$249.99 per lightsaber — splurge-worthy for Star Wars fans). Alternatively, visit the Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$119.99). After Galaxy's Edge, experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Then transition to the rest of Hollywood Studios — ride Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check showtimes — usually 8:00 or 9:00 PM). This 30-minute water, fire, and projection show is a Hollywood Studios highlight. Arrive 45–60 minutes early for good seats. Exit the park after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go from the Aegean Bliss Resort before heading to the park, or Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge for a Ronto Morning Wrap (~$13)
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken), Smoked Kaadu Ribs, and Batuu-inspired beverages (~$16–$24 per person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — unique drive-in movie dining experience with burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes while watching classic sci-fi film clips (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop and Droid Depot reservations must be made in advance and are an additional cost — budget accordingly if interested. Fantasmic! Dining Packages are available and include guaranteed seating; book 60 days in advance. Stay hydrated and use the Cooling Station near Toy Story Land on hot afternoons.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and Resort Day — take a well-deserved break from the parks. Sleep in and enjoy the Aegean Bliss Resort amenities. Spend the morning at the resort pool, relax on the beachfront, or explore the resort grounds. This mid-trip rest day is essential for recharging before the second half of the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs for the Disney Springs Family Entertainment & Dining afternoon. Explore the free-admission shopping and entertainment district. Visit World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), browse unique shops like Uniqlo, Anthropologie, and LEGO Store. Let kids play at the LEGO Imagination Center. Check out live entertainment on the waterfront stages.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed Disney Springs evening — catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 (IMAX available), visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and entertainment, or watch a live performance at the Marketplace Stage. Browse the waterfront atmosphere as the sun sets over the springs.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort restaurant — enjoy a leisurely buffet or à la carte breakfast with resort views (~$15–$25 per person)
meals.lunch: Wolfgang Puck Bar & Grill at Disney Springs — wood-fired pizzas, fresh salads, and American cuisine in a relaxed atmosphere (~$18–$30 per person)
meals.dinner: The Boathouse at Disney Springs — fresh seafood, steaks, and classic American fare with waterfront views and amphicar boat tours nearby (~$30–$55 per person; mid-range splurge)

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and park — a great budget-friendly afternoon. The Boathouse is a slight splurge but worth it for the atmosphere and quality; book a reservation in advance. Use this day to recharge phones, do laundry, and re-plan any remaining park days based on energy levels. Check weather forecasts for the rest of the week.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour begins! Arrive at EPCOT at park opening. Start in Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature) — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required), Test Track, and Soarin' Around the World. These are best tackled early before lines build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to the World Showcase lagoon, which opens at 11:00 AM. Begin your food and culture tour — travel 'around the world' sampling authentic cuisine and beverages from the 11 country pavilions. Highlights include: Mexico (margaritas and tacos), Norway (School Bread pastry and Frozen Ever After ride), Japan (sushi and Mochi), France (crêpes and macarons), and Canada (Le Cellier Steakhouse). Catch cultural performances and meet international cast members.
day_by_day.evening: Position around World Showcase Lagoon for EPCOT's spectacular EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime show (check current show schedule as programming may change by 2027). The fireworks, music, and water projections over the lagoon are breathtaking. Enjoy a final World Showcase snack or drink while watching. Exit via the International Gateway near France/UK pavilions.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — fresh sandwiches, soups, and rotisserie options; one of EPCOT's best quick-service spots (~$14–$20 per person)
meals.lunch: World Showcase food crawl — budget $20–$30 per person for snacks and small plates across multiple pavilions (school bread in Norway, tacos in Mexico, crepes in France, etc.)
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in Japan Pavilion — entertaining teppanyaki-style dinner with hibachi cooking at your table; great for families (~$30–$50 per person; advance ADR recommended)

day_by_day.notes: The EPCOT Food & Culture experience is best enjoyed slowly — don't rush through World Showcase. Many countries offer unique merchandise and cultural demonstrations. If visiting during EPCOT's International Food & Wine Festival (usually fall) or Flower & Garden Festival (spring/summer), there will be additional food booths throughout the park. Check the My Disney Experience app for current festival offerings in June 2027.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom — start with Kilimanjaro Safaris first thing at park opening (approximately 8:00 AM). Animals are most active in the cooler morning hours. See lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and more on this 18-minute open-vehicle safari through a stunning African savanna recreation. Afterward, explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Pangani Forest Trail for up-close wildlife viewing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Pandora — The World of Avatar for the crown jewel of Animal Kingdom: Avatar Flight of Passage. This breathtaking simulator ride (Lightning Lane highly recommended) simulates flying on a banshee over the bioluminescent world of Pandora. Also ride Na'vi River Journey and explore the stunning Pandora landscape, especially beautiful in afternoon light. Spend time in Africa's Harambe village and ride Expedition Everest in Asia.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Rivers of Light: We Are One nighttime spectacular at the Discovery River Amphitheater (verify show is running in 2027). This beautiful water and light show celebrates the animal kingdom. Alternatively, if the show isn't running, explore the Tree of Life at dusk when the hidden animals in the tree's carvings are beautifully illuminated. Exit the park and enjoy a quiet resort evening.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at Harambe Fruit Market or Kusafiri Coffee Shop near the Africa area — pastries, fruit, and coffee (~$8–$14 per person)
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants; grain bowls, protein options, and blue-colored bao buns with stunning Pandoran decor (~$15–$22 per person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia — pan-Asian cuisine including Mandarin chicken, Kobe beef, and crispy honey chicken in a beautifully themed Himalayan setting (~$22–$40 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (around 8:00–9:00 PM), so plan accordingly. Flight of Passage is one of the most sought-after Lightning Lane selections at all of Disney World — purchase it the moment the park opens. Bring insect repellent as Animal Kingdom's natural landscape can attract mosquitoes, especially in the evening. The park is largely outdoors so sun protection is essential.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a relaxed breakfast at the resort and begin packing. If your flight departs in the afternoon or evening, use the morning for any last-minute Disney Springs shopping for souvenirs, or revisit a favorite park for a few final rides using any unused Lightning Lane credits. Alternatively, enjoy the resort pool one last time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout is typically 11:00 AM; request late checkout if needed). Store luggage with the bell service if your flight is later in the day. Head to Disney Springs for final souvenir shopping at World of Disney or grab a farewell treat — a Mickey Premium Ice Cream Bar, a Dole Whip, or a churro from a park cart. Arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport (allow 45–60 minutes travel time plus 2 hours before your flight).
day_by_day.evening: Depart for Orlando International Airport. Reflect on an incredible week at Disney World! If your flight is delayed or you have extra time at MCO, the airport has a solid selection of dining and shopping options in the main terminal.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a full sit-down meal or buffet as a farewell treat (~$15–$25 per person)
meals.lunch: Disney Springs quick-service farewell meal — Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri for crispy chicken tenders, or Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza for a quick, affordable option (~$12–$18 per person)
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport, or an in-flight meal depending on your departure time and airline

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your flight details and arrange airport transportation the night before. Disney's Magical Express (or equivalent resort transportation service available in 2027) may offer luggage handling services — check with your resort concierge. Leave time to drop off any rental items and ensure all Lightning Lane and My Disney Experience reservations are settled. Take photos of your resort room and final Disney moments — the memories are worth capturing!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

experiences.description: Start your morning with the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes. Then head to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride, one of Disney's most immersive experiences. Explore the bioluminescent Pandora landscape and enjoy themed dining at Satu'li Canteen.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Bay Lake

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment & Dining Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission entertainment district. Enjoy world-class dining at restaurants like The BOATHOUSE or T-REX Cafe, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24, browse unique Disney merchandise, and watch live street performances. A budget-friendly way to enjoy Disney magic without a park ticket.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late evening
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late evening
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. A pre-arranged luxury private transfer (limousine or Disney's Magical Express premium service) whisks you directly to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in to your Beachfront suite, enjoy a welcome amenity tray and champagne prepared by the resort. Unpack, freshen up, and get a good night's rest ahead of your Disney adventure.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or at the airport prior to boarding
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Light late-night room service at Aegean Bliss Resort — recommended: charcuterie board, gourmet sandwiches, and sparkling water or wine from the in-room premium minibar

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange private airport transfer before departure. Confirm online check-in with Aegean Bliss Resort so arrival is seamless regardless of the late hour. Request early park entry wristbands or Magic Bands be ready at the front desk. Set up Disney's My Disney Experience app and link all park tickets and Lightning Lane Multi Pass reservations tonight if possible.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely breakfast at the resort followed by a refreshing stroll along the beachfront. Head to Magic Kingdom for rope-drop opening (typically 9:00 AM). Take advantage of Early Theme Park Entry (available to Disney resort guests) to experience fan-favorite attractions — Space Mountain, Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, and TRON Lightcycle / Run — before the general crowds arrive. Use pre-booked Lightning Lane Individual selections for the most in-demand rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Adventure. Explore Fantasyland and ride classics like Peter Pan's Flight and the Haunted Mansion. Enjoy a mid-afternoon break with a Dole Whip or Mickey Premium Bar from a nearby cart. Return to the resort mid-afternoon (2:00–4:00 PM) for a poolside rest, spa treatment, or a quick nap to recharge — a hallmark of a luxury paced itinerary.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the spectacular evening entertainment. Experience the 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle or the 'Happily Ever After' nighttime spectacular. Secure a premium reserved fireworks viewing experience (book in advance) for the best sightlines with dessert party inclusions.

meals.breakfast: Elegant resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant — freshly made eggs benedict, seasonal fruit, pastries, and specialty coffees
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom (Beast's Castle, Fantasyland) — prix-fixe lunch with French-inspired cuisine in a stunning ballroom setting; advance reservation essential
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle — an iconic, immersive fine-dining experience with princess character meet-and-greets, premium entrées, and castle views; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Book Lightning Lane Multi Pass and Individual Lightning Lane selections at 7:00 AM on the day of visit. Cinderella's Royal Table reservations open 60 days in advance and sell out extremely fast — book the moment your window opens. Wear comfortable premium sneakers or walking shoes. Bring a portable fan and cooling towel for June heat.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a resort spa morning treatment (book in advance at Aegean Bliss Resort's spa) — a 60-minute couples or family massage or a rejuvenating facial to start the day refreshed. Afterward, head to Hollywood Studios for the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience. Arrive in time for Early Entry and head straight to Savi's Workshop to build your own custom lightsaber — a deeply immersive, premium experience (approximately $299 per lightsaber, reservations required). Then board Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a hands-on piloting adventure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the full Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge land, including Oga's Cantina for specialty cocktails and unique beverages (reservations highly recommended). Head to Rise of the Resistance — arguably the most technologically advanced attraction in any Disney park worldwide — using a pre-booked Lightning Lane Individual selection. Afterward, explore other Hollywood Studios highlights: Tower of Terror, Slinky Dog Dash, and Toy Story Land. Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort pool if energy dips.
day_by_day.evening: Experience 'Fantasmic!' — Hollywood Studios' breathtaking nighttime water and projection spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse and beloved Disney villains. Secure a Fantasmic! Dining Package (dinner at a participating restaurant included with premium reserved Fantasmic! seating) for a stress-free, best-in-park viewing experience.

meals.breakfast: In-resort private dining or resort restaurant — smoked salmon bagels, avocado toast, fresh-squeezed juices, and espresso
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina for themed specialty drinks and light bites (reservations required), followed by a quick-service premium stop at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo for hearty Star Wars-themed plates
meals.dinner: Hollywood & Vine (Fantasmic! Dining Package) — a character dining buffet with premium seasonal offerings, or Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant for a nostalgic, upscale drive-in cinema dining experience with gourmet American cuisine

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations are essential and book up weeks in advance — confirm before the trip. Oga's Cantina has a strict reservation policy and limited capacity. The Fantasmic! Dining Package must be booked separately through Disney Dining. June temperatures can exceed 90°F — plan indoor breaks and stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent resort morning — sleep in, enjoy breakfast with lagoon or beachfront views, and take a leisurely swim at the resort's premium pool. Head to EPCOT by mid-morning for the EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour. Begin in Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature) and experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (pre-book Lightning Lane Individual) and Soarin' Around the World for stunning aerial panoramic views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enter the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM and embark on a curated food and beverage journey across all 11 country pavilions. Sample authentic dishes and wines in France (crepes, macarons, Bordeaux), Japan (sushi, sake), Morocco (lamb tagine), Italy (gelato, Barolo), and more. Consider booking a private EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival guided tour or a sommelier-led tasting experience (available seasonally) for an elevated cultural immersion.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the EPCOT evening with 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' — one of the largest nighttime spectacular productions ever created for Disney parks, featuring fireworks, music, and stunning water projections over World Showcase Lagoon. Secure a premium IllumiNations or Harmonious Dessert Party with reserved lagoon-view seating for the ultimate experience.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — eggs made to order, premium pastries, fresh tropical fruit platters, and specialty lattes at Aegean Bliss Resort
meals.lunch: Chefs de France in the France Pavilion at EPCOT — an authentic Parisian brasserie experience with French onion soup, duck confit, and fine French wines; advance reservation recommended
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (upstairs from Chefs de France, France Pavilion) — EPCOT's most upscale fine-dining restaurant with a Michelin-quality tasting menu, exceptional wine list, and panoramic World Showcase Lagoon views; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Monsieur Paul is one of the hardest reservations to secure in all of Walt Disney World — book at the 60-day mark precisely. The EPCOT World Showcase officially opens at 11:00 AM daily. Wear lightweight, breathable clothing for outdoor pavilion walking in June heat. Consider a midday return to the resort or an indoor attraction break between 1:00–3:00 PM.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for Disney's Animal Kingdom. Take advantage of Early Theme Park Entry and head directly to Avatar: Flight of Passage — the park's crown jewel attraction — before lines build. This breathtaking ride simulates flying on a banshee over the bioluminescent world of Pandora and is consistently rated the #1 attraction in Walt Disney World. Explore Pandora — The World of Avatar, including the Na'vi River Journey boat ride.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Kilimanjaro Safaris experience — a 20-minute open-air safari through 110 acres of authentic African savanna habitat, home to real lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and over 30 species of African wildlife. For a premium upgrade, book a 'Wild Africa Trek' — a small-group, behind-the-scenes guided safari experience with gourmet bush-style snacks, exclusive wildlife viewing platforms, and a personal photographer (approximately $189–$249 per person, advance booking essential). Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for additional wildlife encounters.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed, resort-focused evening. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for sunset cocktails at the beachfront bar, a private cabana dinner by the pool, or a romantic in-suite dining experience curated by the resort's private dining team. Alternatively, visit Disney Springs for world-class entertainment and shopping.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast or grab-and-go premium options from the resort's café — yogurt parfaits, fresh pastries, cold brew coffee — to make Early Entry at Animal Kingdom
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most artistic and sophisticated table-service restaurant, featuring globally inspired cuisine (South African bobotie, Whole Roasted Fish, premium charcuterie), fine wines, and stunning hand-painted murals celebrating Disney's worldwide travels; advance reservation required
meals.dinner: Private in-suite dining at Aegean Bliss Resort — a curated 3-course meal with champagne and a beachfront dessert platter, arranged through the resort's concierge

day_by_day.notes: Wild Africa Trek is one of Disney's most exclusive premium add-on experiences — book as early as possible (opens 180 days in advance). Tiffins is consistently ranked among the best restaurants in all of Walt Disney World and is beloved by food critics — do not skip it. Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 7:00–8:00 PM), so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full resort morning — indulge in a premium spa treatment (hot stone massage, facial, or hydrotherapy circuit), lounge by the beachfront pool with a tropical cocktail, or take a private resort watercraft or paddleboard rental on the lagoon. This is a deliberate rest and recovery day built into a luxury itinerary to prevent theme park fatigue and keep energy high.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs for the Disney Springs Family Entertainment & Dining Experience. Explore the 120+ shops, including premium boutiques like Anthropologie, Tommy Bahama, Pandora, and the massive World of Disney store. Visit unique entertainment venues: check out Splitsville Luxury Lanes (upscale bowling and dining), catch a film at the AMC Disney Springs 24 with premium recliner seating, or explore the LEGO Store and Art of Disney gallery.
day_by_day.evening: Cap the Disney Springs evening with premium entertainment and world-class dining. Enjoy a live music performance at Jock Lindsey's Hangar Bar or House of Blues. Stroll the waterfront promenade under the lights for a magical, relaxed Disney evening without the theme park crowds.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — a lavish buffet or à la carte service with panoramic beachfront views, fresh tropical juices, eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, and artisan pastries
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — a waterfront upscale restaurant specializing in prime aged steaks, fresh seafood, and oysters; enjoy lunch on the open-air dock overlooking the water with optional amphicar boat tour add-on
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — a modern, high-energy steakhouse with premium USDA dry-aged cuts, creative cocktails, and a vibrant atmosphere; one of Disney Springs' most celebrated fine-dining experiences; advance reservation recommended

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free admission with no park ticket required — a great budget-neutral option for the day. The BOATHOUSE's Amphicar Tours (vintage amphibious vehicles that drive into the water) are a unique, memorable experience — book at the dock on the day. STK Orlando is very popular on summer evenings; book well in advance. Use this day intentionally as a recovery day — 5 days of theme park activity in June heat is demanding.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final luxurious resort morning. Sleep in and savor a leisurely farewell breakfast with the family. Take a last stroll along the beachfront or a final dip in the resort pool. Pack and prepare for checkout. Arrange luggage assistance and a resort bell service pickup. If your flight allows, visit the resort's gift shop for premium Disney keepsakes and souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout typically 11:00 AM; request late checkout at 1:00 PM through concierge if flight timing allows). Board your pre-arranged private luxury transfer to Orlando International Airport with ample time before your departure flight. Reflect on an extraordinary week of world-class Disney magic, premium dining, and unforgettable family memories.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando. If your flight is an evening departure, consider spending a final few hours at Disney Springs (no park ticket needed) for last-minute shopping and a farewell lunch before heading to the airport.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — order your favorites from the full menu: Belgian waffles, eggs made to order, fresh-pressed juices, and a final round of specialty coffees or mimosas
meals.lunch: Either a final Disney Springs meal (quick-service or casual dining depending on flight time) or an airport lounge experience at Orlando International — United Club Lounge if flying United, offering premium snacks, cocktails, and comfortable seating
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or at your destination

day_by_day.notes: Request late checkout (1:00 PM) from the resort concierge at least 48 hours in advance — subject to availability but often granted for premium suite guests. Pre-arrange airport transfer the evening before departure. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for Orlando International Airport during summer peak travel season. Consider enrolling in TSA PreCheck or CLEAR for expedited security screening. Take a final photo at the resort before departure to commemorate the trip.
